The accompanying ZIP repacks all 58 original files from RustFS Functional Chain
[39711742431/1](https://github.com/rustfs/rustfs/actions/runs/39711742431),
artifact 12397696964. Every member's name and bytes were compared with the
downloaded original. It is a regression fixture, not the official ZIP bytes;
the official archive digest is
`e9ab49593f0423f0649066aa71325d59fadc0e7e6d0328071e2f06f45790325f`.

The original result is FAIL/cleanup FAIL. Nine successful seed request/ACK pairs
precede one closed historical GET. The observer rejected its diagnostic version
field, no contender PUT was submitted and H2 never started. The original three
lock events also show an already dropped guard. This archive cannot establish
an acquired timeout window or canonical acceptance. Its stopped physical scene
and reserved owner are used only to authorize non-destructive isolation.
